title: Observability, SLOs, capacity planning
summary: Knowing your system is healthy: metrics, logs, traces, percentiles done right, SLOs and error budgets, burn-rate alerts, capacity planning.

labs.title: Mergeable latency histogram with a relative-error bound, Prometheus-style quantiles, fleet aggregation
Rolling SLO tracker, error budget, burn rate and multi-window burn-rate alert evaluator

outcomes.text: Choose between metrics, logs and traces for a debugging question; estimate time-series cardinality and log volume; design trace and log correlation across sync and async hops.
Apply the golden signals, RED and USE; page on user-visible symptoms (SLO burn, synthetic probes) and keep causes on dashboards and tickets.
Explain why averages hide the tail and why percentiles cannot be averaged; compute fleet-wide percentiles correctly by merging counts.
Compare histogram designs (fixed buckets with interpolation, log-linear with relative error, HDR, t-digest), place bucket edges on SLO thresholds, and derive a sketch's bucket count and error bound.
Implement a concurrency-safe, mergeable latency histogram with a guaranteed relative error, plus a Prometheus-style quantile estimator (labs/a8/histogram).
Measure latency correctly: coordinated omission, open vs closed-loop load generation, and where to take the SLI measurement.
Define SLIs, SLOs and SLAs for a money-movement API (valid vs good events, request- vs time-based, per-tenant fairness) and compute error budgets.
Compute burn rates and time to exhaustion, derive multi-window multi-burn-rate alert thresholds, and evaluate alert quality (precision, recall, detection and reset time).
Implement a rolling SLO tracker and a multi-window burn-rate evaluator with no sleeps (labs/a8/burnrate).
Plan capacity: queueing knee, Little's law for pools, headroom for AZ loss and deploys, forecasting with calendar peaks, and open-loop load tests.
Design telemetry pipelines that drop rather than block, sample sensibly, and keep sensitive data and audit records out of debug telemetry.
Compose SLOs across serial dependencies and define freshness SLOs for asynchronous pipelines.
